owner_note: OWNER NOTE: fictional example. Replace with your vendor's name, API base URL and endpoints from their documentation. Record here the contract / terms-of-use version you accepted and the permissible purposes the vendor approved your account for.

people_search.owner_note: OWNER NOTE: what this search returns, which agency/officer confirmed you may run it for which case, and any vendor restriction on re-use of the results.

address_history.owner_note: OWNER NOTE: address history for a vendor person id returned by people_search. Note the purpose the vendor requires and who authorised it.

vehicle_registration.owner_note: OWNER NOTE: motor-vehicle records are covered by the DPPA. Only enable this if the vendor and the agency have confirmed a DPPA purpose applies to you for this case. Replaced (review 2026-10-16): subject_params was ["plate"], so one authority covered the same plate in every state; the subject is now plate and state, recorded as e.g. --subject "ABC1234 OH".

subscriber_records.owner_note: OWNER NOTE: placeholder for a source that needs a warrant, court order, subpoena or written consent. Such data should come through, or at the direction of, the agency holding the legal process. Record the warrant in authority.py before enabling.

public_court_index.owner_note: OWNER NOTE: public index example; still audited, no authority needed.
